vibe: Living world, theatrical, old script, deep memories, intimate, mysterious.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. p-6, p-8, p-12. Never cramp content.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid (Control Room Mode). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Use h-full for stretching.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_layout: Asymmetrical. Large imagery, floating text, overlapping elements. Use The 'Tetris' Grid.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-[#050505] transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-6 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1A1A1C] text-[#F4F0E6] hover:bg-[#2A2A2C] transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-6 py-3

chat_bubbles.user: bg-[#1A1A1C] border border-white/5 text-[#F4F0E6] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-5 py-4 max-w-[85%] font-body
chat_bubbles.character: bg-transparent border-l-2 border-[#D4AF37] text-[#F4F0E6] pl-5 py-2 max-w-[90%] font-body text-lg leading-relaxed
chat_bubbles.scene_description: text-center text-[#D4AF37] italic font-heading text-lg my-6 opacity-80

cards.character_card: bg-[#0F0F11] border border-white/5 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/40 transition-all duration-500 overflow-hidden relative group p-0

forms.input: bg-[#0F0F11] border-b border-white/20 hover:border-[#D4AF37] focus:border-[#D4AF37] text-[#F4F0E6] rounded-none px-0 py-3 transition-colors outline-none w-full
forms.label: text-[#A8A8A2] text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em]

visual_effects.texture: Add an SVG noise overlay with opacity-5 and mix-blend-overlay to the main background to kill digital flatness.
visual_effects.glassmorphism: Used strictly for the sticky header and floating chat input. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/70 border-t border-white/5.

animations.page_transition: Fade in with subtle upwards translation (y: 10 -> 0) over 0.6s ease-out.
animations.hover_state: Slight scale (1.02) and border color shift to Gold. Slower transitions (duration-500).
animations.chat_reveal: New messages stagger in from bottom with opacity fade.

hero_background.description: Mysterious cinematic dark landscape with light illuminating through branches. Used for landing page hero background with a heavy dark overlay.

character_placeholder.description: Mysterious hooded figure in a foggy forest. Used as a placeholder for character avatars.

memory_background.description: Surreal portal landscape. Used for the memory timeline section or modal background.

avatar_1.description: Premium portrait photo for Character A.

avatar_2.description: Premium portrait photo for Character B.

instructions_to_main_agent.html_structure: Rely heavily on HTML/Tailwind for structural asymmetry on the landing page. Avoid generic Shadcn cards for marketing; build them raw to allow overlapping.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn strictly for complex interactive components (Dialog, Form, Select, ScrollArea) but customize them heavily to remove the default rounded-md 'Vercel' look. Use rounded-none or very minimal radius.
instructions_to_main_agent.overlay_rule: The hero image MUST have an overlay (e.g. bg-[#050505]/60) so text is highly readable.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-input', data-testid='send-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.motion: Use framer-motion for smooth scrolling and staggered reveals on the dashboard grid. No jerky animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do NOT use #000000, use the specified #050505. Ensure focus rings are visible (ring-1 ring-[#D4AF37]).
